user.title: Connect your home to Laris
user.description: Paste the API key from your Laris dashboard ({dashboard_url} → Connect your home). The key links this Home Assistant to your Laris subscription; you can install now and subscribe later.

data_description.api_key: Shown on the Laris dashboard under Connect your home. Treat it like a password.

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: Only change these if Laris support asked you to.

data_description.api_base: The Laris cloud this home talks to. Leave the default unless you were given a staging address.
data_description.default_language: Used for the spoken subscription prompt when the voice pipeline does not specify a language.

mcp_missing.title: HA-MCP Server not found
mcp_missing.description:
Laris controls your home through the HA-MCP Custom Component, which is not set up yet.

1. Install **HA-MCP Custom Component** from HACS ({hacs_url}) and restart Home Assistant (requires Home Assistant {min_ha_version} or newer).
2. Go to Settings → Devices & services → Add integration → **HA-MCP** and add the **HA-MCP Server** entry.
3. Come back here and choose *Check again*.

You can also skip this for now: Laris will answer, but it cannot control your home until you finish this step from *Reconfigure*.

mcp_not_loaded.title: HA-MCP Server is not running
mcp_not_loaded.description: The HA-MCP Server entry exists but is not loaded. Check Settings → Devices & services → HA-MCP for an error (the first start downloads the server and can take a few minutes), then choose *Check again*.

mcp_enable_auth.title: Allow Laris to reach HA-MCP
mcp_enable_auth.description: The HA-MCP Server must accept Home Assistant access tokens on its webhook so Laris can sign in with its own account. Submitting switches its *Webhook authentication* option to **Home Assistant auth** and enables the webhook; HA-MCP restarts itself afterwards.

tunnel_replace.title: Cloudflared is already configured
tunnel_replace.description: The Cloudflared add-on on this system already has a tunnel token. Laris can replace it with a tunnel that only exposes the HA-MCP webhook, or you can enter a public https address for this Home Assistant instead.

tunnel_failed.title: Tunnel setup failed
tunnel_failed.description:
The Laris tunnel could not be set up: {error}

You can retry, enter a public https address for this Home Assistant instead, or skip for now.

manual_url.title: Public address of this Home Assistant
manual_url.description: Laris could not find a public address for this Home Assistant (no Home Assistant Cloud remote access, no https external URL). Enter the https address this Home Assistant is reachable at from the internet, for example {example_url}. {error}

data_description.base_url: Only the HA-MCP webhook path is used; nothing else needs to be exposed.

connector_unreachable.title: Laris could not reach your home
connector_unreachable.description:
Your home was registered with Laris at {base_url}, but the cloud could not reach it: {error}

If HA-MCP is still starting, wait a minute and retry. You can also change the address, or finish now — Laris will keep trying and a repair will show until the home is reachable.

connector_error.title: Could not register with Laris
connector_error.description: Registering your home with the Laris cloud failed: {error}

reauth_confirm.title: New Laris API key
reauth_confirm.description: Your Laris API key was rejected — it was probably regenerated on the dashboard ({dashboard_url} → Connect your home). Paste the new key.

reconfigure.title: Re-check the home connection
reconfigure.description: Laris will look for the HA-MCP Server again, find the public address of this Home Assistant ({base_url} today) and register it with the cloud. Continue to re-run the connection setup.

progress.mcp_wait: Waiting for the HA-MCP Server to start. The first start downloads the server and can take a few minutes.
progress.tunnel_install: Installing and starting the Cloudflared add-on with a tunnel issued by Laris.
progress.connector_register: Registering this home with Laris and checking that the cloud can reach it.

error.invalid_auth: The API key was rejected by the Laris cloud. Copy it again from the dashboard.
error.forbidden: This home is not allowed to connect (suspended). Contact Laris support.
error.timeout: Timed out contacting the Laris cloud.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Laris cloud. Check the internet connection.
error.invalid_url: Enter a full https address, for example {example_url}.

abort.reauth_successful: The new API key was saved.
abort.unit_mismatch: This key belongs to a different home than the one configured here.

init.title: Homapel Conversation
init.description: Tune per-installation settings. Changes apply on the next utterance.

data_description.converse_sock_read: Maximum time the cloud may go silent mid-request before the call is aborted. Bounds the model's think-time and gaps between streamed deltas; the request as a whole is unbounded so long answers won't be truncated.
data_description.unified_pipeline: Lets the cloud start generating speech while the answer is still being written, so replies begin playing sooner. Applies only to voice pipelines that use Homapel for speech-to-text, conversation and text-to-speech together; other pipelines are unaffected. Turn off to make each step wait for the previous one.

home_not_connected.title: Laris cannot control your home yet
home_not_connected.description: Your Laris subscription is linked, but the cloud has no way to reach this Home Assistant, so voice commands cannot control anything. Install the HA-MCP Custom Component from HACS, add its HA-MCP Server entry, then open Settings → Devices & services → Homapel Conversation → Reconfigure to connect your home.

home_unreachable.title: Laris cannot reach your home
home_unreachable.description: The Laris cloud has been unable to reach this Home Assistant for more than 15 minutes. Check that the HA-MCP Server is running, that remote access (Home Assistant Cloud, your external URL or the Cloudflared add-on) is up, then open Settings → Devices & services → Homapel Conversation → Reconfigure to re-check the connection. Status: {dashboard_url}.
